description: Explain a POSIX file mode. Accepts octal (755, 0755, 4755) or the 9-character ls form, with an optional leading type character. s and t mean the execute bit is also set; S and T mean the special bit without execute. setuid, setgid and sticky are the high octal digit. value is the mode as a decimal integer. Returns JSON with: value, octal, octal4, symbolic, setuid, setgid, sticky, owner. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/file-mode
name: file_mode
title: File Mode
